title: 冰法师
identity: 白金长发、冰蓝眼、宽檐尖帽、雪花晶体法杖
design: An adult 24-year-old ice sorceress with platinum blonde long hair, icy blue eyes, a confident mischievous smile, a large asymmetrical midnight blue pointed witch hat decorated with one prominent snowflake crystal and silver clasps. She wears a tailored midnight blue and icy white off-shoulder spellcaster dress, fitted bodice with a subtle neckline, a side slit revealing one thigh, long gloves, thigh high dark boots and flowing translucent-looking ice blue cape panels. She pivots while casting, one bent knee stepping forward, one hand firmly holding a long straight silver staff topped by a large six-point snowflake crystal, the other open palm projecting a few sharp floating ice shards outward. Cold blue magic curls behind her shoulders, not across her face. Background: ancient snow-covered stone tower ruins under a winter night sky, soft blue moonlight, restrained luminous ice reflections.

title: 光牧师
identity: 浅金长发、金绿眼、百合发饰、日轮权杖
design: An adult 20-year-old female holy priestess with long pale golden hair, warm gold-green eyes, a bright gentle reassuring smile, a white lily hair ornament and a small golden sun emblem. Youthful adult facial features and slim grown-woman proportions. She wears an ivory white and gold ceremonial healer gown, open shoulders, elegant modest neckline, fitted waist, asymmetrical layered skirt with one side slit, flowing detached long sleeves, white high boots and a long ivory scarf with gold trim. She is turning and reaching a hand toward the viewer as if offering healing, one knee softly bent, her long hair and scarf sweeping to the opposite side, the other hand holding a clear slender golden staff with a circular sun-shaped head. A few warm golden healing motes hover around the open palm. Background: a luminous stone cathedral garden, tall distant arches, morning golden light, white lilies and restrained soft atmosphere, face clearly separated from the light background.

title: 风精灵弓箭手
identity: 长尖耳、浅绿长发、翡翠眼、叶片弓
design: An adult 22-year-old female woodland elf archer with clearly visible long pointed elf ears, long pale mint green hair partly tied into a high ponytail, emerald green eyes, an alert playful confident expression and a leaf-shaped gold hair clasp. She wears a forest green leather fitted ranger bodice with tasteful shoulder and waist exposure, short layered leaf-shaped skirt panels over opaque fitted shorts, a slim utility belt, one long fingerless arm guard, high leather boots and a small flowing hooded cape. A dynamic three quarter shooting pose: torso turning toward the viewer, front knee bent, one hand holding a visibly curved leaf-carved longbow, other hand drawing a single arrow and its straight taut bowstring back near her cheek, with clear believable arm and hand positions. The arrow and bow remain away from the eyes, no overlapping bow limbs. Her ponytail and green cape stream sideways in a wind gust, a few leaves tracing the motion. Background: a sun-dappled ancient forest with distant ruins and mist, emerald wind light, clean foreground, bright skin contrasting against the deeper green woodland.

title: 火女战士
identity: 赤红高马尾、琥珀眼、黑金轻甲、宽刃大剑
design: An adult 25-year-old female fire swordswoman with long vivid crimson hair in a high ponytail, amber eyes, a bold challenging smile and athletic adult feminine proportions. She wears well-constructed obsidian and brass fantasy light armor, a fitted breastplate with a modest neckline, uncovered shoulders and strong arms, red cloth waist panels, a short asymmetrical armored skirt over fitted opaque battle shorts, thigh armor on one leg, sturdy high boots and a torn scarlet cape flowing backward. She lunges forward from a three quarter angle with one knee bent, holding one large broad straight sword by its clearly defined hilt across her upper body and diagonally beside the shoulder, blade fully visible and not blocking the face, the other hand balancing her movement, expressive dynamic hips and shoulders. Fire glows along the sword edge with a few sparks trailing away from the face. Background: dark volcanic basalt ruins and a restrained red lava horizon, warm orange rim light, clear face illumination, no clutter or excessive flames.

title: 雷巫女
identity: 黑紫长发、紫瞳、朱红结绳、御币与符札
design: An adult 19-year-old Japanese-style shrine maiden with long black hair with dark violet highlights, violet eyes, youthful adult facial features, a lively confident smile, a large crimson ribbon and tiny fox mask pinned near one temple. She wears an original fantasy miko outfit clearly based on a white kimono top and crimson hakama, fashioned into a fitted off-shoulder white wrap bodice with a tasteful neckline, very wide flowing detached sleeves, red waist knot, asymmetrical crimson pleated skirt with one thigh slit, opaque fitted undershorts, white tabi-style high boots. She is mid-step in a sweeping ceremonial dance, one leg lifting naturally, torso and shoulders turning, hair and long sleeves spiraling around the movement. One hand holds a gohei ritual wand with crisp white folded paper streamers, the other hand spreads a few rectangular blank talisman papers without readable writing. A small purple lightning arc connects the talismans away from her face. Background: a moonlit Japanese shrine with a distant red torii gate, wet stone steps, violet storm clouds and restrained electric light, clearly readable silhouette.

title: 星魔法少女
identity: 粉色双马尾、蓝绿眼、星形胸针、星杖与飘带
design: An adult 19-year-old magical heroine with pink long twin ponytails, turquoise eyes, a cheerful confident smile, youthful adult face and slim fully grown woman proportions. She wears an original pink, ivory and lavender magical heroine costume, a fitted bodice with a large gold star brooch, open shoulders, tasteful small waist cutouts, short layered flared skirt with opaque fitted safety shorts, long gloves, knee high white boots, large ribbons and flowing translucent-looking ribbon tails; no school uniform. A lively airborne twirling pose with believable adult proportions, one knee bent, other leg extended diagonally, hair and skirt ribbons following the spin. One hand raises a slender wand with a large five-point star head at the side of the picture, the other arm reaches openly toward the viewer, face unobstructed. A controlled swirl of pink and violet starlight follows the wand motion. Background: distant fantasy town rooftops under a deep twilight sky, gentle cosmic sparkle and soft luminous star glow, uncluttered lower area.
